# Deduplication by identity, names and printing.
builder
prim i integer in=count
prim i2 integer in=total
prim d double
str s unrestricted in=label
str s2 unrestricted
prim b bool n=Flag
prim nul null
arr a i in=counts
arr a2 i
cls c x:i,y?:s,z:a n=Point
cls c2 y?:s,x:i,z:a in=Other
ucls u open x:i
top Top c
top Second u
finish printonrewrite
print
gc
print
